eligibility: exactly two threshold clicks across all twelve returned modes, one on a control rail (modes 0, 1) and one on a target rail (modes 2, 3)

outcomes.meaning: control rail then target rail of the click

compilation_seeds.rule: nonzero draw values in index order, repeats skipped; 144 compilation seeds in schedule order, then the bootstrap seed

preregistered.estimator: linear inversion of the 144 x 4 outcome frequencies onto the 16 x 16 Choi matrix, then the nearest completely positive trace-preserving map by Dykstra alternating projections
preregistered.process_fidelity: F_pro = <Phi_CZ| J |Phi_CZ> / 16 for the Choi matrix J of trace 4

bootstrap.kind: parametric multinomial resample of every setting's eligible events; the basic interval, chosen by the coverage study in forecast.json

preregistered.pooling: both jobs; a missing setting leaves the estimate undecided and its subset descriptive
descriptive: per-setting eligible share of the two-click samples
comparison with the retained noise forecast
preregistered.vendor_comparison: 93.8 +- 0.6 % CNOT fidelity of the vendor chip, descriptive only: a different gate on a calibrated, uncompiled-per-setting chip
preregistered.interpretation: service-compiled average postselected CZ; preparation, readout and gate errors are not separable because every setting compiles to its own mesh
